description: End-to-End Python implementation of "FedSight AI" multi-agent system for Federal Funds Target Rate prediction (NeurIPS 2025 Workshop). Simulates FOMC deliberations using LLMs with Chain-of-Draft reasoning and In-Context Learning. Integrates structured macro indicators with unstructured narratives (Beige Book, Dot Plots).
